watch.summary: The creator reacts in complete wide-eyed shock to a Valorant pro match replay, shouting about 'home advantage' buffs.

beats.what: Creator watches stage footage of pro players reacting to a crazy round.
Creator turns wide-eyed to the camera shouting about home advantage being real.
The broadcast replay shows the impressive in-game kills.
Creator yells at the camera asking what kind of buff home advantage is.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: What is this home advantage buff bro, what?!
watch.why: The creator's exaggerated wide-eyed facial expressions and high energy deliver good visual comedy. However, the joke relies heavily on understanding Valorant esports context.
